tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate text between languages using Lara Translate. Supports language detection, context-aware translations, translation memories, and glossaries. The optional 'instructions' parameter accepts short localization directives (e.g., 'Translate formally') — only provide them when the content specifically requires tone, formality, or terminology adjustments. IMPORTANT: 'target' accepts exactly one language code per call. If the user asks to translate into multiple languages (e.g., 'into Italian and German'), call this tool once per target language and present all resulting translations together. IMPORTANT: 'glossaries' requires glossary IDs in the 'gls_*' format, not glossary names. If the user refers to a glossary by name (e.g., 'our company glossary', 'the marketing glossary'), call list_glossaries first, match the name, and use the returned ID here. If no matching glossary is found, tell the user instead of guessing an ID.

translatable.description: Whether the block should be translated. Omitted on response blocks the engine treats as wholly translatable.

text.description: An array of text blocks to translate. Each block contains a text string and a boolean indicating whether it should be translated. This allows for selective translation where some text blocks can be preserved in their original form while others are translated. Max 128 blocks per call: split larger inputs into multiple calls.

source.description: The source language code (e.g., 'en-EN' for English). If not specified, the system will attempt to detect it automatically. If you have a hint about the source language, you should specify it in the source_hint field.

target.description: The target language code (e.g., 'it-IT' for Italian). This specifies the single language you want the text translated into. This field accepts ONE language code only. If the user wants the text translated into multiple languages, call this tool once per target language.

context.description: Additional context string to improve translation quality (e.g., 'This is a legal document' or 'Im talking with a doctor'). This helps the translation system better understand the domain.

instructions.description: Optional list of short localization directives to adjust translation output. Keep each instruction short (about 20 words). These are NOT free-form LLM prompts — they are expert localization directives about formality, tone, or domain-specific terminology. Only provide instructions when the content specifically requires them; omitting instructions for general content preserves higher translation quality. Do NOT combine contradictory instructions (e.g., formal and informal tone together). Examples: 'Translate formally', 'Use a creative and concise tone', 'Make translation gender-neutral', 'Mask any price with the [price] placeholder', 'Use quotation marks (« ») for quotations'.

source_hint.description: Used to guide language detection. Specify this when the source language is uncertain to improve detection accuracy.

adapt_to.description: A list of translation memory IDs (format 'mem_*') for adapting the translation. If the user refers to a memory by name rather than by ID, call list_memories first to resolve the name to its ID before calling this tool.

glossaries.description: Array of glossary IDs to apply during translation (max 10). IDs must match format: gls_* (e.g., ['gls_xyz123', 'gls_abc456']). Glossaries enforce specific terminology and terms. If the user refers to a glossary by name rather than by ID (e.g., 'my company glossary'), call list_glossaries first to resolve the name to its ID before calling this tool.

no_trace.description: Privacy flag. If set to true, the request content will not be stored or traced by Lara. Use for sensitive content.

priority.description: Translation priority. 'normal' for real-time translations, 'background' for batch processing with lower priority.

timeout_in_millis.description: Custom timeout for the translation request in milliseconds. Max: 300000ms (5 minutes). Useful for very long texts.

style.description: Controls how the translation balances accuracy against natural readability. 'faithful' stays close to the source, 'fluid' prioritizes natural readability, 'creative' allows more freedom in the translation.

reasoning_effort.description: Lara Think reasoning level. Requires reasoning: true; defaults to high.

reasoning.description: Enables Lara Think multi-step linguistic analysis. Can increase processing time up to 10x but may improve translation quality for complex texts.

content_type.description: Specifies the content type of the text. Autodetected if omitted.

translatable.description: Whether the block should be translated. Omitted on response blocks the engine treats as wholly translatable.

items.description: Translated text blocks, in the same order and structure as the input. Blocks marked translatable: false are preserved verbatim.

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detects the language of the provided text. Returns the detected language, content type, and a list of predictions with confidence scores. Accepts a single string or an array of strings (up to 128 elements). Use this tool explicitly whenever the user asks to know or confirm what language a text is written in — including when that request is combined with a translation request (e.g., 'detect the language of this text and translate it into English'). In that case, call this tool first, tell the user which language was detected, and only then call the translate tool (you do not need to pass the detected language as 'source' to translate — translate can auto-detect on its own — but the user still expects to be told the result of detection).

text.description: The text to detect the language of. Can be a single string or an array of strings (up to 128 elements).

hint.description: Optional language code hint to guide detection (e.g., 'en-EN').

passlist.description: Optional list of language codes to restrict detection results to.

contentType.description: Content type of the analysed text

predictions.description: Ranked list of candidate languages with confidence scores

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Lists all supported languages in your Lara Translate account.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: Lists all translation memories in your Lara Translate account.

externalId.description: External identifier (e.g. MyMemory ID) when imported

collaboratorsCount.description: Number of collaborators with access to the memory

isPersonal.description: True if the memory is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

items.description: Translation memories accessible to the authenticated account

tools.name: create_memory
tools.description: Create a translation memory with a custom name in your Lara Translate account. Translation memories store pairs of source and target text segments (translation units) for reuse in future translations.

name.description: The name of the new memory, it should be short and generic, like 'catch_phrases' or 'brand_names'

external_id.description: The ID of the memory to be imported from MyMemory. Use this to initialize the memory with external content. Format: ext_my_[MyMemory ID]

externalId.description: External identifier (e.g. MyMemory ID) when imported

collaboratorsCount.description: Number of collaborators with access to the memory

isPersonal.description: True if the memory is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Updates a translation memory in your Lara Translate account.

id.description: The unique identifier of the memory to update. Format: mem_xyz123

name.description: The new name for the memory

externalId.description: External identifier (e.g. MyMemory ID) when imported

collaboratorsCount.description: Number of collaborators with access to the memory

isPersonal.description: True if the memory is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Deletes a translation memory from your Lara Translate account.

id.description: The unique identifier of the memory to update. Format: mem_xyz123

externalId.description: External identifier (e.g. MyMemory ID) when imported

collaboratorsCount.description: Number of collaborators with access to the memory

isPersonal.description: True if the memory is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

tools.name: add_translation
tools.description: Adds a translation to a translation memory in your Lara Translate account.

id.description: The ID or list of IDs where to save the translation unit. Format: mem_xyz123

source.description: The source language code of the sentence, it MUST be a language supported by the system, use the list_languages tool to get a list of all the supported languages

target.description: The target language code of the translation, it MUST be a language supported by the system, use the list_languages tool to get a list of all the supported languages

sentence_before.description: The sentence before the source sentence to specify the context of the translation unit

sentence_after.description: The sentence after the source sentence to specify the context of the translation unit

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of units in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: delete_translation
tools.description: Deletes a translation from a translation memory in your Lara Translate account.

id.description: The ID or list of IDs where to delete the translation unit from. Format: mem_xyz123

source.description: The source language code of the sentence

target.description: The target language code of the translation

sentence_before.description: The sentence before the source sentence to specify the context of the translation unit

sentence_after.description: The sentence after the source sentence to specify the context of the translation unit

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of units in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: import_tmx
tools.description: Imports a TMX file into a translation memory. This is an async operation that returns an import job object containing an import_id. Poll with check_import_status using the returned import_id until the import is complete.

id.description: The ID of the memory to update. Format: mem_xyz123.

tmx_content.description: The content of the tmx file to upload.

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of units in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: check_import_status
tools.description: Checks the status of a TMX import job started by import_tmx. Poll this tool with the import_id returned from import_tmx until the import is complete. The response includes a progress field to track completion.

id.description: The ID of the import job

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of units in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: list_glossaries
tools.description: Lists all glossaries in your Lara Translate account. Glossaries are collections of terms with their translations that enforce specific terminology during translation.

isPersonal.description: True if the glossary is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

items.description: Glossaries accessible to the authenticated account

tools.name: get_glossary
tools.description: Retrieves a specific glossary by ID from your Lara Translate account. Returns null if the glossary is not found.

isPersonal.description: True if the glossary is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

glossary.description: The requested glossary, or null when no glossary has that id

tools.name: create_glossary
tools.description: Create a glossary with a custom name in your Lara Translate account. Glossaries enforce specific terminology during translation.

name.description: The name of the new glossary, it should be short and descriptive, like 'brand_terms' or 'legal_terminology'

isPersonal.description: True if the glossary is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

tools.name: update_glossary
tools.description: Updates the name of a glossary in your Lara Translate account.

name.description: The new name for the glossary

isPersonal.description: True if the glossary is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

tools.name: delete_glossary
tools.description: Deletes a glossary from your Lara Translate account.

id.description: The glossary ID to delete (format: gls_*, e.g., 'gls_xyz123')

isPersonal.description: True if the glossary is private to the owner. Omitted for some account types (e.g. team plans).

tools.name: add_glossary_entry
tools.description: Adds or replaces an entry in a glossary in your Lara Translate account. Supports both monodirectional and multidirectional glossaries.

language.description: The language code of the term. Use the list_languages tool to get supported languages.

value.description: The term value in the specified language

terms.description: Array of terms with language and value. For monodirectional glossaries, the first term is the source and the rest are targets. For multidirectional glossaries, all terms are treated equally. Use the list_languages tool to get supported language codes.

guid.description: Optional entry identifier. Use this for multidirectional glossaries or to update a specific entry.

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of entries in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: delete_glossary_entry
tools.description: Deletes an entry from a glossary in your Lara Translate account. Use term for monodirectional glossaries or guid for multidirectional glossaries.

term.description: The term to delete. Use this for monodirectional glossaries.

language.description: The language code of the term

guid.description: The entry GUID to delete. Use this for multidirectional glossaries.

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of entries in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: import_glossary_csv
tools.description: Imports a CSV file into a glossary. Supports unidirectional and multidirectional formats. This is an async operation that returns an import job object containing an import_id. Poll with check_glossary_import_status using the returned import_id until the import is complete.

csv_content.description: The content of the CSV file to upload

content_type.description: The format of the CSV file. 'csv/table-uni' for unidirectional, 'csv/table-multi' for multidirectional

gzip.description: Whether the CSV content is gzip compressed

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of entries in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: check_glossary_import_status
tools.description: Checks the status of a glossary CSV import job started by import_glossary_csv. Poll this tool with the import_id returned from import_glossary_csv until the import is complete.

id.description: The ID of the glossary import job

channel.description: Channel identifier used by the import

size.description: Total number of entries in the import

progress.description: Import progress between 0 and 1 (1 means complete)

tools.name: export_glossary
tools.description: Exports a glossary as CSV from your Lara Translate account. Supports unidirectional and multidirectional formats.

content_type.description: The export format. 'csv/table-uni' for unidirectional (requires source parameter), 'csv/table-multi' for multidirectional

source.description: The source language code. Required when content_type is 'csv/table-uni'

value.description: The exported glossary content serialised as CSV

tools.name: get_glossary_counts
tools.description: Retrieves the term and language counts for a glossary in your Lara Translate account.

unidirectional.description: Entry counts keyed by language code for unidirectional glossaries

multidirectional.description: Total entry count for multidirectional glossaries
